notes.title: Upcoming Big Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,
As a result of your feedback, new mechanics, high-definition customizable main character (no longer wearing masks) and many new game systems will come with the second season. This update will come with season 2. We are working hard on it. New mechanics have been tested and are being integrated into the game. Stay tuned for a big update coming soon.
Have Fun!

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
As a result of a small mistake, the portal to the other map was not opening. This bug has been fixed.
In the last map of Season 1, the creatures could not move. This bug has also been fixed.
We continue to fix bugs for a better gaming experience.
Have Fun!
